title: 第96章 真是奸商我要投诉第95章 吱哇乱叫的婴孩
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
好吧！合着一切全是他们自己脑补过头了……
这个结论虽然离谱，但好像才是真相，三人为之前真心实意对师姐的仰慕感到悲伤，他们白感动了。
“我能去找那位师兄，也帮我们揍人么？”
赵致然一想到那几个，把他当肥羊欺辱的人就直恨得牙痒痒。
李婉和木青同时用关爱傻子的眼神看向赵致然。
“你说呢？”
师兄出头是因为那些人冒犯了香炉宗，可不是因为所谓的同门爱。
“好吧。”赵致然不甘地低下头，哼！迟早有一天，他要报回昨日的仇。
三人原路返回。
回到宗门后，直奔青云阁。
青云阁的师姐验完货后，将贡献点划到了木青的云栩之上。
这次他们共采了一百四十七个蜜参果，三人一个没留，全换成了贡献点，总共得七千三百五十贡献点。
三人均分，一人也能得两千四百五巨款呢！
这一趟超值！
三人眼睛冒光地看着自己的云栩，无论多么努力也不能阻止嘴巴上扬的弧度。
木青一收到贡献点，就立马给李婉和赵致然转了属于他们的那一部分。
师姐从案后的椅上站起来，趴在桌案上，冲三人友好一笑，接着又仿若闲聊道：
“你们此行去摘蜜参果，想必已经看到那群小孩了吧。”
“小孩？师姐您是说阴槐树洞里那些阴灵？”
师姐含笑点头，

“他们可还好，脾气暴躁否？可有哭闹？”
“师姐为何这般关心那群阴灵？”
李婉将云栩收起，她也对阴槐树洞内那些阴灵的来历感到好奇。
听这位师姐的话意，她应该是知道些事情始末的，故而也趁此和她攀谈起来。
“蜜参果并非多珍稀之物，宗门之所以给蜜参果设如此之高的价值，便是想要接任务的弟子去采灵果之时，顺便陪陪那些小阴灵。”
所以，她们这些贡献点，实际上是两件事的工资？
采蜜参果和帮宗门看小孩的？
李婉看向木青，用眼神询问，你知道这一茬么？
木青摇头。
不知道啊，她要是知道，便不会接这个任务。
“他们有的脾气暴躁，有的哭了，有的没哭，我们走的时候他们睡得很安心。”李婉选择依实作答。
“睡得很安心，那是何意？”
几人便将树洞中之事大概说了一下，这事并非隐私，说了也无碍。
师姐听后点点头，心下暗叹，有了这波真心奉上的守护之气，树洞中的婴孩应能长大些了。
李婉想起树洞里满地上乱爬，懵懂幼小的阴灵，问道，“师姐可知，他们是何来历？”
此事并不是个刚入门的外门弟子该知道的，不过看在三人无心中办了好事的份上，师姐倒是可以透露一二。
“此事说起来都是孽啊。”
“五百年前，西地有一邪修，为炼制魂幡，杀千数刚出生的婴儿，毁其尸骨，抽其魂灵入幡，炼制成了阴灵。
婴孩制成的阴灵，乃至纯至恶之物，在他正要进行下一步之前，遇见了宗主。”
“东地乃九成之地皆是香炉宗属地，容不得这般邪魔歪道在此造次，宗主亲自出手，那邪修自然不是对手，魂幡被破，千数阴灵得以解脱。
content_en:
All right! Everything they co-wrote is all over their heads...
Although this conclusion is outrageous, it seems to be the truth. The three of them felt sad for their sincere admiration for the senior sister before, and they were moved in vain.
"Can I go find that senior brother and beat someone up for us too?"
When Zhao Zhiran thought of those people who bullied him like a fat sheep, his teeth itched with hatred.
Li Wan and Mu Qing looked at Zhao Zhiran with caring eyes at the same time.
"What do you think?"
Senior brother came forward because those people offended the Xianglu Sect, not because of the so-called love of fellow disciples.
"Okay." Zhao Zhiran lowered his head reluctantly, hum! Sooner or later, he will take revenge for yesterday.
The three of them returned the same way.
After returning to the sect, he went straight to Qingyun Pavilion.
After the senior sister from Qingyun Pavilion inspected the goods, she assigned the contribution points to Mu Qing's Yun Xu.
This time they collected a total of one hundred and forty-seven honey ginseng fruits. None of the three of them kept any. They all exchanged them for contribution points, for a total of seven thousand three hundred and fifty contribution points.
If three people share it equally, one person can get a huge sum of two thousand four hundred and five hundred!
This trip is worth it!
The three of them looked at Yun Xu with gleaming eyes. No matter how hard they tried, they could not stop the upward curve of their mouths.
As soon as Mu Qing received the contribution points, he immediately transferred their portion to Li Wan and Zhao Zhiran.
The senior sister stood up from the chair behind the case, lay down on the desk, gave the three of them a friendly smile, and then said as if chatting:
"You went to pick honey ginseng fruits on this trip. You must have seen those children."
"Child? Senior sister, are you talking about those ghost spirits in the cave of the locust tree?"
Senior sister smiled and nodded,
"Are they okay? Are they grumpy? Are they crying?"
"Why do senior sisters care so much about those Yin spirits?"
Li Wan put Yun Xu away, and she was also curious about the origins of the ghosts in the locust tree cave.
From what this senior sister said, she should know the whole story, so I took this opportunity to chat with her.
"The honey ginseng fruit is not a very rare thing. The reason why the sect places such a high value on the honey ginseng fruit is because the disciples who want to take on the mission can accompany the little Yin spirits when they go to collect spiritual fruits."
So, their contributions are actually wages for two things?
The one who collects honey ginseng fruits and helps the sect take care of the children?
Li Wan looked at Mu Qing and asked with her eyes, do you know about this?
Mu Qing shook his head.
I don’t know. If she knew, she wouldn’t accept this task.
"Some of them were grumpy, some cried, and some didn't cry. They slept peacefully when we left." Li Wan chose to answer truthfully.
"Sleeping peacefully, what does that mean?"
A few people briefly talked about what happened in the tree hole. This matter was not private, and there was no harm in talking about it.
The senior sister nodded after hearing this and secretly sighed in her heart. With this wave of sincere protective energy, the baby in the tree hole should be able to grow up.
Li Wan thought of the ignorant young Yin spirits crawling all over the ground in the tree hole, and asked, "Sister, do you know where they came from?"
This matter is not something that a new outer disciple should know, but since the three of them did something good unintentionally, the senior sister can reveal a few things.
"It's a sin to talk about this."
"Five hundred years ago, there was an evil cultivator in the West. In order to refine soul flags, he killed thousands of newborn babies, destroyed their bones, extracted their souls into the flags, and refined them into Yin spirits.
The yin spirit made of a baby, or even a pure evil thing, met the sect leader before he was about to take the next step. "
"Ninety percent of the land in the east is the territory of the Xianglu Sect, and there is no room for such evil and crooked ways to cause trouble here. The sect leader personally took action, and the evil cultivator was naturally no match. The soul flag was broken, and thousands of Yin spirits were liberated.
